dialogues.jp:
抵抗するのもかったるい。もう、どうにでもし
てくれってところだ。
dialogues.en: It's a scent that I first notice.
dialogues.text: It's a scent that I first notice.

dialogues.jp:
はてさて、どんな眠りの王国へ連れて行かれる
のやら……。
dialogues.en:
It's a scent of either perfume or flowers. It's such a nice
smell that I want to be embraced by the scent forever.
dialogues.text:
It's a scent of either perfume or flowers. It's such a nice
smell that I want to be embraced by the scent forever.

dialogues.en: Where am I......?
dialogues.text: Where am I......?

dialogues.jp: ここは、どこだ……？
dialogues.en:
"Hey, Yoriko. It's a beautiful day... The morning air feels
so good..."
dialogues.text:
"Hey, Yoriko. It's a beautiful day... The morning air feels
so good..."

dialogues.jp:
「ねえ、頼子、今日もいい天気ね。すう、はあ、
　すう、はあ……。朝の空気、気持ちいい……」
dialogues.en: "...Do you think... he'll take this road again today...?"
dialogues.text: "...Do you think... he'll take this road again today...?"

dialogues.jp: 「……あの人……今日もあの道通るかな……？」
dialogues.en:
"Of course he will. This is his school route. As long as he
goes to school, he'll walk along this road every day..."
dialogues.text:
"Of course he will. This is his school route. As long as he
goes to school, he'll walk along this road every day..."

dialogues.jp: 誰だろう？　見知らぬ人。見たことのない部屋。
dialogues.en: Who is it? I don't recognize the person or this room.
dialogues.text: Who is it? I don't recognize the person or this room.

dialogues.jp: 女の子だ。顔は……よく分からない。
dialogues.en: It's a girl. I can't really see her face.
dialogues.text: It's a girl. I can't really see her face.

dialogues.jp:
「ね、頼子。これって考えてみれば素晴らしい
　偶然よね」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko, don't you think this is a wonderful coincidence?"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko, don't you think this is a wonderful coincidence?"

dialogues.jp:
「私は、この窓辺に座って、外を眺めるのが好
　きで……」
dialogues.en: "I like to sit near this window, watching outside, and..."
dialogues.text: "I like to sit near this window, watching outside, and..."

dialogues.jp: 「あの人は、あの道から学校に通っていて……」
dialogues.en: "He goes along this road to his school every day..."
dialogues.text: "He goes along this road to his school every day..."

dialogues.jp:
「私は偶然にも、あの人を知るようになり、自
　然と目で追うようになった……」
dialogues.en:
"I happened to recognize him and naturally started to watch
him walk by......"
dialogues.text:
"I happened to recognize him and naturally started to watch
him walk by......"

dialogues.jp:
あの人？　通学路？　一体、誰の事なんだ？　
彼女の視線の先にそれはあるらしいが、どう
にも俺には分からない……。
dialogues.en:
Who is he? A school route? Who is she talking about? It
seems like she's looking at it, but I don't understand......
dialogues.text:
Who is he? A school route? Who is she talking about? It
seems like she's looking at it, but I don't understand......

dialogues.jp:
「でも、あの人の隣によく居る黄色いリボンの
　女の子、あの子は誰なんだろう……？　最近
　は見ないけど……」
dialogues.en:
"But I wonder who was that girl with a yellow ribbon who was
walking with him. But I haven't seen her lately......"
dialogues.text:
"But I wonder who was that girl with a yellow ribbon who was
walking with him. But I haven't seen her lately......"

dialogues.jp:
「……まさか、恋人？　可愛いし、とても仲が
　良さそうに見えるし……」
dialogues.en:
"......Is she his girlfriend? She was a cute girl, and they
looked very close......"
dialogues.text:
"......Is she his girlfriend? She was a cute girl, and they
looked very close......"

dialogues.jp:
「あの人の前に立って、目を見つめて、おしゃ
　べり出来たらどんなに楽しいだろうな……」
dialogues.en:
"How fun would that be if I could stand in front of him and
talk with him, looking into his eyes......?"
dialogues.text:
"How fun would that be if I could stand in front of him and
talk with him, looking into his eyes......?"

dialogues.jp:
黄色いリボンの女の子？　黄色いリボン……黄
色い……。
dialogues.en:
A girl with a yellow ribbon? Yellow ribbon......
Yellow......
dialogues.text:
A girl with a yellow ribbon? Yellow ribbon......
Yellow......

dialogues.en: (Hmmm...... Who is it......?)
dialogues.text: (Hmmm...... Who is it......?)

dialogues.jp:
脳の｛ひだひだ／襞々｝のどこかに答えが隠れている気がする。
が、どうしても見つからない。
dialogues.en:
I feel like I have the answer in my brain somewhere but I
can't find it.
dialogues.text:
I feel like I have the answer in my brain somewhere but I
can't find it.

dialogues.jp: （電磁子？　……いや、それは黄色い鈴か）
dialogues.en: (An electric magneton? ......No, that's a yellow bell.)
dialogues.text: (An electric magneton? ......No, that's a yellow bell.)

dialogues.jp:
あの特徴的な語尾が｛のうり／脳裡｝に浮かぶ間にも、女の
子の述懐は続く。
dialogues.en:
The girl keeps reminiscing while the distinguishing sounds
enter my mind.
dialogues.text:
The girl keeps reminiscing while the distinguishing sounds
enter my mind.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、私じゃ無理よね。お互い通っている学
　校が違うし、出会いなんてないだろうし」
dialogues.en:
"But I can't be his girlfriend. I go to another school and
I'll have no chance to meet him."
dialogues.text:
"But I can't be his girlfriend. I go to another school and
I'll have no chance to meet him."

dialogues.jp:
「ふう……私も風見学園にすれば良かったのか
　な……」
dialogues.en: "I should have gone to Kazami Academy......"
dialogues.text: "I should have gone to Kazami Academy......"

dialogues.jp: 聞き慣れた単語が、ぽんと飛び出した。
dialogues.en: It's a familiar name.
dialogues.text: It's a familiar name.

dialogues.jp:
してみるとここは、初音島在住の女の子の部屋
なのか？
dialogues.en:
So I guess this is the room of a girl who lives on Hatsune
Island.
dialogues.text:
So I guess this is the room of a girl who lives on Hatsune
Island.

dialogues.jp: 「……お父様が許すはずないわよね、そんな事」
dialogues.en: "......But my father wouldn't have allowed it anyway."
dialogues.text: "......But my father wouldn't have allowed it anyway."

dialogues.jp:
部屋の中を見回す。広い。それに、思わず書き
割りかと思ってしまうくらい、高価そうな調度
品の数々。
dialogues.en:
I look around the big room. There are many expensive
furnishings that I've only seen in movies.
dialogues.text:
I look around the big room. There are many expensive
furnishings that I've only seen in movies.

dialogues.jp: そして、“お父様”なる｛たえ／妙｝なる響き。
dialogues.en: And the way she calls her dad 'my father' sounds so weird.
dialogues.text: And the way she calls her dad 'my father' sounds so weird.

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、猫を膝に載せた少女は、なかなかの
お嬢様であるらしかった。
dialogues.en: It looks like the girl with a cat on her lap is a rich girl.
dialogues.text: It looks like the girl with a cat on her lap is a rich girl.

dialogues.jp: 「頼子……お前はいいわね、自由で」
dialogues.en:
"Yoriko...... it must be nice to be you because you have so
much freedom."
dialogues.text:
"Yoriko...... it must be nice to be you because you have so
much freedom."

dialogues.jp:
「自由……そう、私と違って、まるで切手のよ
　うに｛どこ／何処｝へでも行ける……」
dialogues.en:
"Freedom...... Unlike me, you can go anywhere, like stamps
on postcards."
dialogues.text:
"Freedom...... Unlike me, you can go anywhere, like stamps
on postcards."

dialogues.jp: 「……あの人のところへだって」
dialogues.en: "......You can even go to him."
dialogues.text: "......You can even go to him."

dialogues.jp: いいやねえ、うんうん。恋する乙女って奴だね。
dialogues.en: It's good to see a lady in love...
dialogues.text: It's good to see a lady in love...

dialogues.jp:
けど、猫相手にぐずぐず言っているのは、ちと
減点ではあるな。
dialogues.en: Except for the part that she's complaining to a cat.
dialogues.text: Except for the part that she's complaining to a cat.

dialogues.jp:
恋なんて当たって砕けろだ。……まあ、当事者
はそうも行かないかもしれんけど。
dialogues.en:
Love is anything other than direct...... It's easier said
than done.
dialogues.text:
Love is anything other than direct...... It's easier said
than done.

dialogues.jp:
「そうだ、頼子。お前……招き猫って言葉は知っ
　てる？」
dialogues.en: "I have an idea, Yoriko. You know about the beckoning cat?"
dialogues.text: "I have an idea, Yoriko. You know about the beckoning cat?"

dialogues.jp:
「ねえ、お願い。あの人を……あの人の気持ち
　を私の方へ招いて」
dialogues.en:
"Please do me a favor. Please beckon his heart to come to
me."
dialogues.text:
"Please do me a favor. Please beckon his heart to come to
me."

dialogues.jp: 「おいおい、猫に頼ってどうするよ」
dialogues.en: "Oh my god... She is asking a cat for help."
dialogues.text: "Oh my god... She is asking a cat for help."

dialogues.jp:
──思わず、そんな言葉が漏れた。しかし、無
論の事、彼女には届かない。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't help saying that loud. But she can't hear me
anyway.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't help saying that loud. But she can't hear me
anyway.

dialogues.jp:
静かな｛ていねん／諦念｝。まるで、薄皮を何枚も何枚も貼り
合わせていったような、気弱さ。
dialogues.en:
A quiet tone of resignation. Mental cowardice made with many
thin layers of skin.
dialogues.text:
A quiet tone of resignation. Mental cowardice made with many
thin layers of skin.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、彼女の口調から、そんなものを読み取っ
ていた。
dialogues.en: That's what I see in her from the way she talks.
dialogues.text: That's what I see in her from the way she talks.

dialogues.jp:
たぶん、俺からは窺えないその表情も、それに
相応しいものなのだろう。
dialogues.en:
The expression on her face that I can't really see might
tell me the same things.
dialogues.text:
The expression on her face that I can't really see might
tell me the same things.

dialogues.jp:
「駄目だっての、そんなじゃさ。ああ、もう、
　かったるいな……」
dialogues.en:
"It won't do any good if you are weak like that. Oh,
dear..."
dialogues.text:
"It won't do any good if you are weak like that. Oh,
dear..."

dialogues.jp:
聞こえないのが分かっていて、それでも言葉を
せき止める事が出来ない。
dialogues.en:
I knew she couldn't hear me but I still couldn't help saying
it loud.
dialogues.text:
I knew she couldn't hear me but I still couldn't help saying
it loud.

dialogues.jp:
「そうやって座って、見ていたって、恋は実ら
　ないぜ？　どんなにかったるくても、行動を
　起こさないと」
dialogues.en:
"Just sitting and watching like that isn't going to make you
his girlfriend. You have to do something, even though it's a
pain."
dialogues.text:
"Just sitting and watching like that isn't going to make you
his girlfriend. You have to do something, even though it's a
pain."

dialogues.jp:
「そりゃ、必ずしも実るとは限らない。でも
　……」
dialogues.en:
"Of course, you may not be able to be his girlfriend even if
you try hard..."
dialogues.text:
"Of course, you may not be able to be his girlfriend even if
you try hard..."

dialogues.jp:
「種をまかなきゃ、それはもう１２０パーセン
　ト実らないんだぜ？」
dialogues.en:
"But if you don't do anything, there's 120% chance that you
won't be his girlfriend."
dialogues.text:
"But if you don't do anything, there's 120% chance that you
won't be his girlfriend."

dialogues.jp: 届かない。届かない。少女には少しも。
dialogues.en: She can't hear me. Not at all.
dialogues.text: She can't hear me. Not at all.

dialogues.jp: それが、ひどくもどかしかった。
dialogues.en: It's really frustrating.
dialogues.text: It's really frustrating.

dialogues.jp: 少女の願いは──祈りは、なおも続く。
dialogues.en: Her wish -- her prayer continues.
dialogues.text: Her wish -- her prayer continues.

dialogues.jp: 「お願い、頼子。あの人を……あの人を……」
dialogues.en:
"Please, Yoriko...... Please beckon his heart...... his
heart......"
dialogues.text:
"Please, Yoriko...... Please beckon his heart...... his
heart......"

dialogues.en: "Ah, Yoriko......!?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Yoriko......!?"

dialogues.jp: 溶暗。
dialogues.en: Everything starts to fade out.
dialogues.text: Everything starts to fade out.

dialogues.jp: （うおっ！）
dialogues.en: (Wow!)
dialogues.text: (Wow!)

dialogues.jp:
と思いきや、凄いスピードで地面が──という
か、｛へい／塀｝が迫ってくる。
dialogues.en:
The ground, or should I say a wall, suddenly starts to
approach towards me.
dialogues.text:
The ground, or should I say a wall, suddenly starts to
approach towards me.

dialogues.jp: 落ちている！？
dialogues.en: I'm falling!?
dialogues.text: I'm falling!?

dialogues.en: "Help..."
dialogues.text: "Help..."

dialogues.jp: 「あ？　ふわ、あ……」

でっかいあくびをし、涙ににじんだ視界で周囲
を確認する。
dialogues.en:
I give a big yawn and look around, with tears in my eyes
from yawning.
dialogues.text:
I give a big yawn and look around, with tears in my eyes
from yawning.

dialogues.jp: 「……ふう、俺の部屋、か」
dialogues.en: "......Oh, I'm in my room..."
dialogues.text: "......Oh, I'm in my room..."

dialogues.jp:
夢から｛さ／醒｝めれば、そこは紛れもなく見知った部
屋。夢からの生還を実感する。
dialogues.en:
When I wake up from the dream, I'm in my room. And I realize
I've come back alive from a dream.
dialogues.text:
When I wake up from the dream, I'm in my room. And I realize
I've come back alive from a dream.

dialogues.jp: 「さて……お休み」
dialogues.en: "Well...... good night."
dialogues.text: "Well...... good night."

dialogues.jp:
目をつむって１０秒もしないうちに、目覚まし
が騒ぎ立て始めた。
dialogues.en:
About 10 seconds after I closed my eyes, the alarm clock
rings.
dialogues.text:
About 10 seconds after I closed my eyes, the alarm clock
rings.

dialogues.jp:
……音夢がどこからか遠隔操作してるんじゃな
いだろうな。
dialogues.en: Nemu isn't controlling it with a remote control, is she?
dialogues.text: Nemu isn't controlling it with a remote control, is she?

dialogues.jp: 「しかし、誰がセットしたんだ……？」
dialogues.en: "Who set my alarm clock......?"
dialogues.text: "Who set my alarm clock......?"

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましを止めつつ、首を傾げる。
dialogues.en: I turn it off, puzzled.
dialogues.text: I turn it off, puzzled.

dialogues.jp:
「誰がって……俺しか居ねえよな。だったら、
　何故？」
dialogues.en: "Who can set this alarm other than me? Then why did I?"
dialogues.text: "Who can set this alarm other than me? Then why did I?"

dialogues.jp:
首を傾げつつ、腕を組む。だって今は、春休み
のはず……。
dialogues.en:
I'm still cocking my head with my arms folded. It's spring
break, and...
dialogues.text:
I'm still cocking my head with my arms folded. It's spring
break, and...

dialogues.jp:
そこでようやく思い出した。つい昨日、入学式
とかいう退屈責めを通り抜けたばかりだった。
dialogues.en:
I finally remember. Yesterday I had the entrance ceremony,
which was really boring.
dialogues.text:
I finally remember. Yesterday I had the entrance ceremony,
which was really boring.

dialogues.jp:
どうもあの退屈さがトラウマとなって、心から
消したがっていたらしい。
dialogues.en:
I guess I really wanted to erase the boring day from my
memory.
dialogues.text:
I guess I really wanted to erase the boring day from my
memory.

dialogues.jp:
ベッドから抜け出し、大きく伸びをする。空気
がぬるく、春を肌で実感する。
dialogues.en:
I get out of bed and give a stretch. The air's so warm that
I can tell it's spring.
dialogues.text:
I get out of bed and give a stretch. The air's so warm that
I can tell it's spring.

dialogues.jp:
もさもさと学生服に着替える。そうしながら、
思い出すともなく、夢を思い出していた。
dialogues.en:
I reluctantly change into my school uniform and remember the
dream I just had.
dialogues.text:
I reluctantly change into my school uniform and remember the
dream I just had.

dialogues.jp: 何だったんだろうな、あの夢は。
dialogues.en: What was that all about?
dialogues.text: What was that all about?

dialogues.jp:
「まあ……他人の夢なんて気にしても仕方ない
　けどな」
dialogues.en: "Well...... I really don't care about someone else's dream."
dialogues.text: "Well...... I really don't care about someone else's dream."

dialogues.jp: 呟きが、無人の部屋に拡散していった。
dialogues.en: My murmur spreads through the empty room.
dialogues.text: My murmur spreads through the empty room.

dialogues.jp: ◆少女と猫◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
｛いざな／誘｝われたのは猫を抱いた少女の夢だった。
言動などから推測すると、どうやら少女は初音
島在住、しかもかなりのお嬢様のようだ。
dialogues.en: I'm tired of resisting. I don't care.
dialogues.text: I'm tired of resisting. I don't care.

dialogues.jp:
少女は自ら行動を起こそうとはせずに膝の上に
乗せた猫、「頼子」に叶わぬ恋の願いを託す。
dialogues.en: Well, I wonder what kind of dreamland I'll be taken to......
dialogues.text: Well, I wonder what kind of dreamland I'll be taken to......

dialogues.jp: 自分から動かなきゃ恋は叶わないだろうに……。
もどかしさを感じた俺だった。
